listing.name: Azure Dreams (Azure Dreams HD Recompilation)
listing.summary: Research listing. Upstream route: Documented player/source route downloads framework toolchain, generates base C from own USA disc and rebuilds Windowsruntime. Overlays run interpreted unless separately compiled withcompile_overlays.py--static; preserve hybrid route. ZIP does not prove fully static coverage. Limits: Upstream only: Native base with interpreted overlays unless separately compiled. Full-game and native overlay coverage remain incomplete/Unknown. Base game recompiled; overlays interpreted unless separately compiled via compile_overlays.py --static. Windows route; retain hybrid scope and unqualified full-game state. Upstream platforms: Windows 10 source/toolchain preparation and release ZIP. Other player platforms not established. Original data: PS1 Azure Dreams USA SLUS-00614 own disc, OpenBIOS bundled. Exact source revision/hash and BIOS/firmware requirements not stated above remain Unknown in this review. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
